what_it_is: 100% save file with a capped-stats leader Blissey. Most legendary treasure items looted,Blissey has a setup with the Lucky Scarf that lets it live forever in most dungeons once you start to starve. 100% adventure log and living dex . 300h~

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 128 KiB EEPROM (cut 262144 -> 131072; the rest was all 0xFF)
